title: Owen Muir on The Wavelength Podcast
subtitle: Two truths and a lie!
body_html:
The Frontier Psychiatrists is a daily-ish newsletter — and I love a good podcast appearance. I joined my friend Dr. Sarah Adler on her podcast, the Wavelength. We discuss prescribing medicine —or not! As an aside, I have a book we discuss called inessential pharmacology.

Thanks for listening!
